title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability… (CVE-2026-107306)
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Menu Link Attributes allows Stored XSS. This issue affects Menu Link Attributes versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.8.0.
